name: GEA College
summary: Private business school in Ljubljana; its Faculty of Entrepreneurship offers one part-time, fee-paying bachelor's in English, with a US-degree option.

ib.text: GEA says IB diplomas need no recognition procedure; general matura holders are eligible, with ranking on grades if places are limited. Proof of B2 in the language of study is asked for.

programmes.name: Entrepreneurship
programmes.about: Part-time professional degree (180 ECTS) in entrepreneurship, marketing and management, with real company projects, two internship blocks and a business plan; lectures are on weekday afternoons and Saturday mornings.
programmes.ib: Part-time and fee-paying for everyone; the English-language version is mentioned on the faculty page, not on the programme page, so confirm it runs for your intake.
programmes.selectionNote: If places are limited: 60% overall matura (IB) result, 40% grades of school years 3–4. The programme may not run if too few apply.

notes: The faculty page says it also offers the Entrepreneurship programme in English and a 3+1+1 route to a St. Francis College (New York) degree; the programme page itself does not name the language.
The other undergraduate programmes (Entrepreneurship and Management, Digital Marketing, Information and Cybersecurity) are not described as English-taught.
The tuition page gives one price for Slovenian, EU and EEA students and a higher one for non-EU students; foreign students pay the whole programme in advance at the first-year rate.
